messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "tell healthcare provider if someone in household has abused drugs"
set: ["tell healthcare provider if someone in household has abused drugs", "tell healthcare provider if living in household with small children", "tell healthcare provider if mouth effects are severe", "tell healthcare provider immediately if given by injection", "tell healthcare provider if taking prescription or over-the-counter medicines", "tell healthcare provider if taking vitamins or herbal supplements", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe", "call healthcare provider if pain gets worse", "call healthcare provider if have new pain", "if light blinks red, call healthcare provider", "if device falls off, call healthcare provider", "tell healthcare provider about all medical conditions before taking", "call healthcare provider right away if hearing voices", "call healthcare provider if more sensitive to pain", "inform healthcare provider if pregnant or planning pregnancy"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
